## Review
The subject matter was good, but the density of the composition and the foreshadowing laid out in advance are too weak.

In particular, the ```unique number``` motif is too flimsy and forced.  
The criteria for being discovered cannot be clear.  
How much of the body is allowed? Does it only apply to discovery in the macroscopic world? Where does that person end?  
It seems better not to use such elements.  

The female protagonist is a typical villain. A very frustrating character.

I wonder if the ending scene really had to be included.
